figures.titleZh: 现实 → 痕迹 → 讯号 → 运行体 → 观察阈值
figures.titleEn: Reality → Trace → Signal → Runtime → Observation Threshold
figures.runtimeMeaning: Reality leaves traces; signals require persistence/context evaluation; runtime reading requires lineaged evidence; threshold crossing is reviewed rather than assumed.

figures.titleZh: 从感官到人工智能：观察解析度历史
figures.titleEn: From Senses to AI: History of Observation Resolution
figures.runtimeMeaning: Observer/tool class changes resolution and coverage but never grants automatic reality authority.

figures.titleZh: 痕迹 → 证据 → 知识状态图谱
figures.runtimeMeaning: Evidence is admitted through source, reliability, integrity, relevance, conflict and boundary checks before a knowledge state is assigned.

figures.titleZh: 观察 → 测量 → 解析度 → 误差 → 不确定性
figures.runtimeMeaning: Numeric observations require object definition, units, scale, baseline, sampling/window, calibration/comparability, error and uncertainty metadata.

figures.titleZh: 现实／证据／重构／投影权威边界
figures.titleEn: Reality / Evidence / Reconstruction / Projection Authority Boundary
figures.runtimeMeaning: Evidence supports bounded reconstruction; runtime plus evidence plus constraints may enter conditional projection; projection never outranks reality.

runtime48Boundary.rule: The 48-position runtime matrix remains Book VI/runtime-position structural knowledge. Book VII may observe and govern its use but does not redefine FIG 14E as the matrix.
